result.assistantText: Both screens from the plan are already built, so there was nothing left to generate. The light and dark dashboards share the same layout: header with logo and wordmark, the four-tab strip with a green underline, the 2x2 metric grid showing dashes, two quick actions, and recent receipt rows. The dark screen uses its own fixed dark colors because the theme supports only one mode, so it won't update if the theme changes.
